notes: No Slurm job is submitted and no GPU is allocated by this client. Root coordinates the eight-GPU ceiling and an exclusive loopback replica.
At each length, measure one full batch at concurrency four, then measure higher concurrency only when its projected KV peak fits the declared headroom.
The next-point projection is the last measured peak KV fraction times its concurrency ratio times the safety multiplier. This is a memory-admission heuristic, not a measured result.
All measured requests have the same forced 4096-token decode length. Full-batch request counts grow with concurrency; total work therefore differs across points.
Missing live KV telemetry, any preemption, token-count mismatch or request failure prevents recommendations for that point. Skipped concurrency levels are explicitly unmeasured.
No held-out records, labels or biological responses are used. This synthetic completions workload does not assess answer quality or reproduce chat/thinking prompts.
The 45056-token profile measures independent synthetic long prompts, not the shared-prefix P16 workload. No production inference setting is edited by the client.
This allocation includes concurrency-one/two pilots so independent 45k-token prompts can be validated on A100 without assuming four fit.
